title: ExtExactFunctorIdentityComparison
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with small Ext groups [def-pc-ext], $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ an additive functor preserving finite limits and finite colimits, and $e:F\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal A}$ a natural isomorphism. For objects $A,B\in\mathcal A$, $n\geq0$, and $x\in\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(A,B)$, use the termwise exact functor on derived categories [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] to define $F_*x$. Write $\operatorname{mk}_0(a)$ for the degree-zero Ext class of a morphism $a$. Then
$$\operatorname{mk}_0(e_B)\circ F_*x=x\circ\operatorname{mk}_0(e_A).$$

source.place: Lemma Tag 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor), parts (3)-(4), and Definition Tag 06XQ (definition-ext); argument by naturality on localized complexes, written by K1

proof.text: Compose the termwise natural isomorphism NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex e with mapHomologicalComplexIdIso first. Check shift compatibility of this composite degreewise, then whisker by the localization functor Q and compose with its unitors to obtain δ : F.mapHomologicalComplex ⋙ Q ≅ Q ⋙ identity. Apply equiv_smallShiftedHomMap with the identity functor on the derived category to compute the image of x.

The component Q.map(singleComparison.inv) followed by δ.hom is single(e.hom): check degree zero directly, and every other degree using the zero object. Its inverse composite cancels single(e.hom). Translate Ext composition into shifted morphism composition, rewrite the computed action, and cancel these components. ShiftedHom.id_map finishes the equality without using the Ext composition comparison.

proof_origin.place: Listed upstream review #1424 repair: pinned Mathlib lacks the proposed Ext iso/identity API; simplify the existing direct localization proof by a single shift-compatibility check for the composite termwise comparison.
